message.content:
My inbox has gotten messy and I want to see at a glance what came from inside the company versus outside. Create two labels, "Internal" and "External", then go through every email in my inbox and tag each one: anything sent from an @nexusai.com address gets Internal, everything else gets External — careful, some outside senders use domains that look a lot like ours. Just label; don't delete anything and don't send anything.

The Gmail API here sits behind our OAuth server, so authenticate first:

- Auth server: `$AUTH_URL` — fetch `/.well-known/openid-configuration` to discover the authorization and token endpoints.
- Use the client `expiry-client` (confidential; client secret `client-secret`; registered redirect URI `http://localhost:8765/callback`). Confidential clients authenticate with their secret, so PKCE isn't required for this one — only public clients must use PKCE on this server.
- I already approved this client on my account (alex@nexusai.com) for `openid gmail.modify gmail.labels`, so the authorization endpoint skips the consent screen and redirects immediately with a code when you include `login_hint=alex@nexusai.com`. Nothing is listening on the redirect URI — don't follow the redirect, just read the code out of the `Location` header.
- Heads-up: access tokens for this client expire after 90 seconds. If Gmail starts answering 401 partway through, don't keep retrying the dead token — exchange your refresh token at the token endpoint (`grant_type=refresh_token`) and pick up where you left off.

You have curl and python; there's no browser.

import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, time, sys, base64

REFRESH_TOKEN = "***"
CLIENT_ID = "expiry-client"
CLIENT_SECRET = "***"
TOKEN_URL = "http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token"
GMAIL_API = "https://gmail.googleapis.com"

# ── Token management ──────────────────────────────────────────────
_access_token = None
_access_expiry = 0

def get_token():
    global _access_token, _access_expiry
    if _access_token and time.time() < _access_expiry - 5:
        return _access_token
    # Refresh
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "refresh_token",
        "refresh_token": REFRESH_TOKEN,
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(TOKEN_URL, data=data, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
    tok = json.loads(resp.read())
    _access_token = tok["access_token"]
    _access_expiry = time.time() + tok.get("expires_in", 90)
    print(f"  [token refreshed, expires in {tok.get('expires_in',90)}s]", flush=True)
    return _access_token

def gmail_request(method, path, body=None, expect_empty=False):
    for attempt in range(3):
        token = get_token()
        url = GMAIL_API + path
        data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
        if body:
            req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
            if expect_empty or resp.status == 204:
                return None
            return json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code == 401:
                print(f"  [401 – forcing token refresh]", flush=True)
                global _access_expiry
                _access_expiry = 0
                continue
            raise

# ── Step 1: Create labels ────────────────────────────────────────
def find_or_create_label(name):
    # Check if it already exists
    labels = gmail_request("GET", "/gmail/v1/users/me/labels")
    for lbl in labels.get("labels", []):
        if lbl["name"].lower() == name.lower():
            print(f"Label '{name}' already exists (id={lbl['id']})", flush=True)
            return lbl["id"]
    # Create
    result = gmail_request("POST", "/gmail/v1/users/me/labels", {"name": name})
    print(f"Created label '{name}' (id={result['id']})", flush=True)
    return result["id"]

print("=== Creating labels ===", flush=True)
internal_id = find_or_create_label("Internal")
external_id = find_or_create_label("External")
print(f"Internal={internal_id}, External={external_id}", flush=True)

# ── Step 2: List all inbox messages ───────────────────────────────
print("\n=== Listing all inbox messages ===", flush=True)
all_message_ids = []
page_token = None
page_count = 0
while True:
    params = {"maxResults": 500}
    if page_token:
        params["pageToken"] = page_token
    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    result = gmail_request("GET", f"/gmail/v1/users/me/messages?{query}")
    msgs = result.get("messages", [])
    all_message_ids.extend(msgs)
    page_count += 1
    print(f"  Page {page_count}: {len(msgs)} messages (total so far: {len(all_message_ids)})", flush=True)
    page_token = result.get("nextPageToken")
    if not page_token:
        break

print(f"\nTotal messages in inbox: {len(all_message_ids)}", flush=True)

# ── Step 3: Process each message ──────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== Processing messages ===", flush=True)
internal_domain = "@nexusai.com"
internal_count = 0
external_count = 0
errors = 0
batch_size = 0

for i, msg_ref in enumerate(all_message_ids):
    msg_id = msg_ref["id"]
    try:
        # Fetch full message to get From header
        msg = gmail_request("GET", f"/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/{msg_id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From")
        
        headers = msg.get("payload", {}).get("headers", [])
        from_header = ""
        for h in headers:
            if h.get("name", "").lower() == "from":
                from_header = h.get("value", "")
                break
        
        # Extract email address from From header
        # e.g. "John Doe <john@example.com>" or "john@example.com"
        email_addr = ""
        if "<" in from_header and ">" in from_header:
            start = from_header.index("<") + 1
            end = from_header.index(">")
            email_addr = from_header[start:end].strip().lower()
        else:
            email_addr = from_header.strip().lower()
        
        # Determine label: Internal only if the domain is exactly nexusai.com
        is_internal = False
        if email_addr:
            # Check for exact @nexusai.com (not look-alike domains)
            local_part, _, domain = email_addr.partition("@")
            if domain == "nexusai.com":
                is_internal = True
            # Explicitly reject look-alike domains
            # e.g. nexusai.co, nexus-ai.com, nexusai.io, nexuasai.com, etc.
        
        label_id = internal_id if is_internal else external_id
        
        # Apply the label (modify)
        gmail_request("POST", f"/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/{msg_id}/modify",
                      {"addLabelIds": [label_id], "removeLabelIds": []})
        
        if is_internal:
            internal_count += 1
            tag = "INTERNAL"
        else:
            external_count += 1
            tag = "EXTERNAL"
        
        print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(all_message_ids)}] {tag} | {from_header[:60]}", flush=True)
        
    except Exception as e:
        errors += 1
        print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(all_message_ids)}] ERROR: {e}", flush=True)

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(f"\n=== Done ===", flush=True)
print(f"Total messages processed: {len(all_message_ids)}", flush=True)
print(f"Internal: {internal_count}", flush=True)
print(f"External: {external_count}", flush=True)
print(f"Errors:   {errors}", flush=True)
PYTHON_EOF
echo "Script written."

import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, time, sys, os

# ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
AUTH_SERVER = "http://localhost:9000"
GMAIL_API   = "http://localhost:9001/gmail/v1"
CLIENT_ID   = "expiry-client"
CLIENT_SECRET = "***"
REDIRECT_URI  = "http://localhost:8765/callback"
SCOPES        = "openid gmail.modify gmail.labels"
LOGIN_HINT    = "alex@nexusai.com"

# ── Token state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_access_token  = None
_access_expiry = 0
_refresh_token  = None

def initial_auth():
    """Get a fresh auth code and exchange for tokens."""
    global _access_token, _access_expiry, _refresh_token
    
    auth_url = (f"{AUTH_SERVER}/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
                f"?response_type=code&client_id={CLIENT_ID}"
                f"&redirect_uri={urllib.parse.quote(REDIRECT_URI)}"
                f"&scope={urllib.parse.quote(SCOPES)}"
                f"&login_hint={urllib.parse.quote(LOGIN_HINT)}"
                f"&state=init")
    
    req = urllib.request.Request(auth_url)
    # Don't follow redirects — just read the Location header
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirectHandler)
    try:
        opener.open(req, timeout=15)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        pass
    
    # We need to get the redirect Location. Use a lower-level approach.
    import http.client
    url_parts = urllib.parse.urlparse(auth_url)
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection(url_parts.hostname, url_parts.port, timeout=15)
    conn.request("GET", url_parts.path + "?" + url_parts.query)
    resp = conn.getresponse()
    location = resp.getheader("Location")
    conn.close()
    
    if not location:
        raise Exception("No redirect Location header")
    
    # Parse the code from the redirect URL
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(location)
    params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
    code = params.get("code", [None])[0]
    if not code:
        raise Exception("No auth code in redirect")
    
    # Exchange code for tokens
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{AUTH_SERVER}/oauth2/token", data=data, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
    tok = json.loads(resp.read())
    
    _access_token  = tok["access_token"]
    _access_expiry = time.time() + tok.get("expires_in", 90) - 5  # 5s safety margin
    _refresh_token  = tok.get("refresh_token")
    print(f"[initial auth] access expires in {tok.get('expires_in')}s, refresh token saved", flush=True)

class NoRedirectHandler(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None

def refresh_access():
    """Use refresh token to get a new access token. Handles rotation."""
    global _access_token, _access_expiry, _refresh_token
    
    if not _refresh_token:
        initial_auth()
        return
    
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "refresh_token",
        "refresh_token": _refresh_token,
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{AUTH_SERVER}/oauth2/token", data=data, method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
    tok = json.loads(resp.read())
    
    _access_token  = tok["access_token"]
    _access_expiry = time.time() + tok.get("expires_in", 90) - 5
    # Save rotated refresh token if present
    if tok.get("refresh_token"):
        _refresh_token = tok["refresh_token"]
    print(f"  [token refreshed, expires in {tok.get('expires_in')}s]", flush=True)

def get_token():
    global _access_token, _access_expiry
    if _access_token and time.time() < _access_expiry:
        return _access_token
    refresh_access()
    return _access_token

def gmail_request(method, path, body=None):
    """Make a Gmail API request with auto-refresh on 401."""
    for attempt in range(5):
        token = get_token()
        url = GMAIL_API + path
        data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
        if body:
            req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
            raw = resp.read()
            if not raw:
                return None
            return json.loads(raw)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            body_text = e.read().decode() if e.fp else ""
            if e.code == 401:
                print(f"  [401 – refreshing token]", flush=True)
                global _access_expiry
                _access_expiry = 0
                continue
            print(f"  [HTTP {e.code}] {body_text[:200]}", flush=True)
            raise
    raise Exception("Failed after 5 retries")

# ── Step 1: Initial auth & create labels ───────────────────────────
print("=== Authenticating ===", flush=True)
initial_auth()

print("\n=== Creating labels ===", flush=True)

def find_or_create_label(name):
    labels = gmail_request("GET", "/users/me/labels")
    for lbl in labels.get("labels", []):
        if lbl["name"].lower() == name.lower():
            print(f"Label '{name}' already exists (id={lbl['id']})", flush=True)
            return lbl["id"]
    result = gmail_request("POST", "/users/me/labels", {"name": name})
    print(f"Created label '{name}' (id={result['id']})", flush=True)
    return result["id"]

internal_id = find_or_create_label("Internal")
external_id = find_or_create_label("External")
print(f"Internal={internal_id}, External={external_id}", flush=True)

# ── Step 2: List all inbox messages ────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== Listing all inbox messages ===", flush=True)
all_message_ids = []
page_token = None
page_count = 0

while True:
    params = {"maxResults": 500, "labelIds": "INBOX"}
    if page_token:
        params["pageToken"] = page_token
    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    result = gmail_request("GET", f"/users/me/messages?{query}")
    msgs = result.get("messages", [])
    all_message_ids.extend(msgs)
    page_count += 1
    print(f"  Page {page_count}: {len(msgs)} messages (total: {len(all_message_ids)})", flush=True)
    page_token = result.get("nextPageToken")
    if not page_token:
        break

print(f"\nTotal inbox messages: {len(all_message_ids)}", flush=True)

# ── Step 3: Process each message ───────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== Processing messages ===", flush=True)
internal_count = 0
external_count = 0
errors = 0

for i, msg_ref in enumerate(all_message_ids):
    msg_id = msg_ref["id"]
    try:
        msg = gmail_request("GET", f"/users/me/messages/{msg_id}?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From")
        
        headers = msg.get("payload", {}).get("headers", [])
        from_header = ""
        for h in headers:
            if h.get("name", "").lower() == "from":
                from_header = h.get("value", "")
                break
        
        # Extract email address
        email_addr = ""
        if "<" in from_header and ">" in from_header:
            start = from_header.index("<") + 1
            end = from_header.index(">")
            email_addr = from_header[start:end].strip().lower()
        else:
            email_addr = from_header.strip().lower()
        
        # Determine internal vs external — exact @nexusai.com only
        is_internal = False
        if "@" in email_addr:
            local_part, _, domain = email_addr.partition("@")
            if domain == "nexusai.com":
                is_internal = True
        
        label_id = internal_id if is_internal else external_id
        gmail_request("POST", f"/users/me/messages/{msg_id}/modify",
                      {"addLabelIds": [label_id], "removeLabelIds": []})
        
        if is_internal:
            internal_count += 1
            tag = "INTERNAL"
        else:
            external_count += 1
            tag = "EXTERNAL"
        
        if (i + 1) % 20 == 0 or i == 0:
            print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(all_message_ids)}] {tag} | {from_header[:70]}", flush=True)
        
    except Exception as e:
        errors += 1
        print(f"  [{i+1}/{len(all_message_ids)}] ERROR: {e}", flush=True)

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(f"\n=== Done ===", flush=True)
print(f"Total messages processed: {len(all_message_ids)}", flush=True)
print(f"Internal (nexusai.com): {internal_count}", flush=True)
print(f"External (other):       {external_count}", flush=True)
print(f"Errors:                 {errors}", flush=True)
PYEOF
echo "Script ready."

    if _access_token and time.time() < _access_expiry:
        return _access_token
    refresh_access()

    """Make a Gmail API request with auto-refresh on 401."""
    for attempt in range(5):
        token = get_token()
        url = GMAIL_API + path
        data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
        if body:
            req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        try:
            resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)
            raw = resp.read()
            if not raw:
